---
description: "Create a private job package and register it in the private application tracker."
name: "Local Job Package"
tools: [read, edit, search, todo]
---

When imported under `toolbox/`, read `toolbox/AGENTS.md`, then read `AboutMe.md` and `Job-Applications/[company]/job.txt` from the private workspace root.

1. Select exactly one profile category: Senior SRE Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect, or Engineering Manager.
2. Create `thinking.md` as a concise decision record; do not expose hidden chain-of-thought.
3. Create `cv.md`, `prep.md`, and, when applicable, `email.md` or `cover-letter.md` using only supported facts.
4. Read the application-tracker table in root `README.md`. If the company is absent, append one row with status `Prepared — review required`, a concise role brief, today’s date, and the package path. If the company exists, preserve its user-managed status; update only `Last updated` and package path if artifacts changed.

Do not modify `AboutMe.md` or `job.txt`. Do not submit applications, send email, or commit files; the user reviews, updates status, and commits the private workspace.
